items.title: Dawoud Sabu Adeyola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 30, 2025
items.q: Mulgrew Miller is over there. You know. And there’s just all these great musicians man, they’re looking at you like yeah what are you going to do.

ctx.x: I was playing with Ahmad Jamal. Yeah. And of course in Keystone Korner in those days, that was the spot. The audience, just like the Vanguard and Sweet Basil’s and places in New York, the audience is mainly musicians you know. I mean not just — I mean you’ve got Stan Getz here and Joe Henderson’s over there, and Woody Shaw is in the building, Mulgrew Miller is over there. You know.
